headline: Persistent Systems plans to raise up to ₹8,000 crore through bonds

Indian retail investors tracking tech sector expansions and corporate debt levels should note how Persistent funds its inorganic growth.

headline: Persistent Systems shares fall 3% on weaker Q2 earnings as brokerages disagree on future growth
